title: INC-3367: service incident, identity hub
body:
IMPACT:

This report covers an incident on the Identity Hub that is ongoing. Data
Services linked roughly 29 tickets to the event and engaged Pinecrest Hosting,
the hosting provider, within the first hour.

TIMELINE:

Arjun Pillai logged the following events, state as of 7 February 2025:
- The on-call engineer confirmed failed health checks on two nodes
- The previous configuration was redeployed to the whole pool
- Queue depth was sampled every five minutes and charted

STATUS:

Current state of the incident: ongoing. Priya Raman wrote this report on 20
October 2025 and will review it in the 01:00-03:00 UTC window before the weekly
service meeting.
